title: Where we ship.
intro: We concentrate on left-hand-drive markets with established shipping lanes and clear import rules. Each region below lists the destinations we quote most often; if your country is not shown, send us the port and we will confirm feasibility, transit time and documentation.

regions.name: Middle East
regions.summary: Gulf states and the Levant — the strongest demand for full-size SUVs, pickups and GCC-specification vehicles.
regions.logistics: Frequent ro-ro and container sailings from Jebel Ali. GCC specification and Arabic documentation available.

regions.name: Africa
regions.summary: North, West and East African markets, with a focus on durability, parts availability and age-eligible units.
regions.logistics: Age and emission limits vary by country. We screen eligibility before quoting and prepare pre-shipment inspection where required.

regions.name: Latin America
regions.summary: South and Central American buyers of SUVs, pickups and electric vehicles, supplied in left-hand-drive specification.
regions.logistics: Container and ro-ro service via Pacific and Atlantic hubs. Spanish-language documents and homologation checks supported.

regions.name: Central Asia & Caucasus
regions.summary: Fast-growing import corridors for SUVs, crossovers and electric vehicles, served by rail and road as well as sea.
regions.logistics: Rail and road corridors via Khorgos and Alashankou, or sea to Poti and Bandar Abbas. Customs union documentation prepared for EAEU destinations.

regions.name: Southeast Asia
regions.summary: Short-sea and container routes for left- and right-hand-drive markets across the region.
regions.logistics: Left- and right-hand-drive options with short transit times from East Asian ports. Import licensing and inspection requirements confirmed per country.

regions.name: Russia & Belarus
regions.summary: Vehicle supply into Russia and Belarus, subject to sanctions screening and permitted payment routes.
regions.logistics: Every order is screened before quotation. Permitted payment routes, documentation and transport corridors are confirmed in writing.

incoterms.name: Free On Board
incoterms.description: We deliver the vehicle cleared for export on board the vessel at the named origin port. You arrange and pay the main freight and insurance.

incoterms.name: Cost and Freight
incoterms.description: We cover origin costs and ocean freight to your destination port. Risk transfers when the vehicle is loaded on board.

incoterms.name: Cost, Insurance and Freight
incoterms.description: As CFR, with marine insurance arranged and paid by us to the destination port.

incoterms.name: Delivered at Place
incoterms.description: We arrange carriage to an agreed destination point. Import duty, taxes and clearance remain with the buyer unless quoted separately.

logisticsPoints.title: Shipping methods
logisticsPoints.description: Ro-ro for driveable units and containers for mixed or high-value orders. We recommend the method that protects the vehicle and the budget.

logisticsPoints.title: Marine insurance
logisticsPoints.description: All-risk cover available under CIF terms or arranged on your behalf, with the certificate issued in the consignee's name.

logisticsPoints.title: Documentation
logisticsPoints.description: Commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin, export declaration, insurance certificate and destination-specific compliance documents.

logisticsPoints.title: Destination support
logisticsPoints.description: We work with clearing agents at major ports and can introduce a trusted partner, or coordinate with your own broker.
